candidates.summary: Beyond the func-mediated cycle notJoon already reported, every initialization-cycle shape (through a method, a closure, a two-function chain) still aborts gno run with a Go panic, because resolveEffectiveDeps panics with a plain string that runFiles' type switch re-throws at default: panic(r)
candidates.failure_scenario: gno run on a package with `type T struct{}; func (T) M() int { return a }; var a = T{}.M()` (or `var a = func() int { return a }()`, or `var a = f(); func f() int { return g() }; func g() int { return a }`) prints `panic: main/<dir>/main.gno:3:5: circular dependency: a -> T.M -> a [recovered, repanicked]` with a goroutine dump and exits 2, the exact behaviour the PR sets out to remove; a fix or test keyed on the reported func shape alone leaves the method and closure shapes uncovered
candidates.verify_by: build gno at ce6b30394, run GNO=<bin> sh tests/solo-finder-1-cycle-shapes.sh: each of the four cases exits 2 with a circular dependency panic; after a fix (wrap the resolveEffectiveDeps panic in an error or handle it in runFiles) all four exit 1 with one (code=gnoPreprocessError) line
candidates.evidence: head: `ok   cycle_method: exit 2` / `panic: main/cycle_method/main.gno:7:5: circular dependency: a -> T.M -> a [recovered, repanicked]`; `ok   cycle_closure: exit 2` / `panic: main/cycle_closure/main.gno:3:5: circular dependency: a -> a [recovered, repanicked]`; `ok   cycle_twohop: exit 2` / `... circular dependency: a -> f -> g -> a [recovered, repanicked]`. Base 398e5960d: same four exit 2 (not caused by the diff; the diff's goal leaves them). Other recursive shapes are handled at head: `const a = b; const b = a`, `var x = x`, `type A = B; type B = A`, `type I interface{ I }` each exit 1 with `invalid recursive value/type ... (code=gnoPreprocessError)`, since they raise inside Preprocess and are wrapped by doRecover.

candidates.summary: doRecover wraps every panic raised inside Preprocess, internal invariant failures and Go runtime errors included, as *gno.PreprocessError, so runFiles now prints a VM bug as a one-line user source error with exit 1 and drops both the Go stack and the preprocess stack the base panic carried
candidates.failure_scenario: gno run on `func (int) M() {}` prints `g5_builtinrecv/main.gno:3:1-18: should not happen (code=gnoPreprocessError)` and exits 1; a user cannot tell this internal assertion from a mistake in their code, and a bug report carries no trace unless they know to set DEBUG_PANIC=1 (gno lint and gno test already behave this way through printError, so this aligns run with them rather than diverging)
candidates.verify_by: gno run on a file containing `func (int) M() {}` at ce6b30394: one `should not happen (code=gnoPreprocessError)` line, exit 1; at 398e5960d: Go panic with the preprocess stack
candidates.evidence: head run: `== g5_builtinrecv rc=1` / `g5_builtinrecv/main.gno:3:1-18: should not happen (code=gnoPreprocessError)`; doRecover (preprocess.go:690-718) wraps any recovered value, error or not, into &PreprocessError{err, stack}.
